title: Parts has Active and Inactive tabs, Active selected, each with its own parts
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. Seed a few inventory parts (tag throwaway data "ZZAUTOTEST", e.g. part number "ZZAUTOTEST-PKG-1", name "ZZAUTOTEST package part") via New Inventory Part. Set at least one part inactive so both tabs have content.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Parts -> Inventory page.
  2. Read the two tabs and which is selected.
  3. Open the Active tab and confirm every listed part is active.
  4. Open the Inactive tab and confirm every listed part is inactive.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Inventory list shows two tabs, Active and Inactive, with Active selected when the page opens.
  • The Active tab lists only active parts and the Inactive tab lists only inactive parts.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 1 (Active / Inactive tabs); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “The Inventory list shows two tabs, Active and Inactive.”
  • S1-R2: “Active is the selected tab when the page opens.”
  • S1-R3: “The Active tab lists only parts that are active.”
  • S1-R4: “The Inactive tab lists only parts that are inactive.”
